findings.problem: NIT 5 row error builds its suggestion from the raw cell with Number(raw) / 1000. parseKgToGrams accepts a trailing kg/kgs, so a cell such as '60000 kg' under a 'Weight (g)' header produces 'enter NaN (e.g. 0.2)'.
findings.fix: Compute the suggested value from the parsed result (weight.value / 1_000_000) instead of the raw text.

findings.problem: Under a 'Weight (g)' header, real gram values of 50 or less (e.g. 30 for a 30 g sachet) are read as kg and saved as 30 kg with no warning. The guard only fires above 50 kg, as agreed in NIT 5. Fulfilment uses weightGrams for shipping.
findings.fix: Optional: when weightUnitHint === 'g', add a row warning for any weight of 1 or more saying the header names grams but the value is read as kg.

findings.problem: Doc-only round-3 NITs 8 and 13 are not applied yet: §14 has no A-28 (40% GST cannot be entered), and §11 (line 844) still says First Load JS is 'unchanged versus master' instead of 'changes by less than 1 kB'.
findings.fix: Apply both in plan step 6 (finalize) and mention NIT 8 in the final report.
